audit.summary: 82,067 people in 108 H3 cells (Wyre Forest, England); an improvement opportunity: not poorly served, but with a measurable weakness. Weaknesses: 19,216 in cells measured below half the local reference median (52 Mbps, the lower of the area and UK medians); 40,407 in cells whose speeds fell by 30% or more over the last quarters; 7,108 in cells where only 1-2 operators are identified within 5 km; 22,126 in busy cells with a capacity-strain signal. Measured cells are on average 22% below their reference median. 653 Ookla tests in the latest quarter averaging 55.5 Mbps (data confidence: high). Speed fell 55% from the oldest to the latest quarter. On average 2.7 operators have approximate sites within 5 km of its cells (EE, O2, Three, Vodafone somewhere nearby).
